editorialDepth.advantages: Gweike Cloud CO₂ is built for acrylic signage, thick wood, and shop production once exhaust is sorted. 55W adds headroom on panels and multi-pass jobs.
editorialDepth.limitations: Avoid without ducting, for occasional gifts only, or if budget ignores tube replacement, power, and floor space. Bare metal without an IR accessory stays out of scope.
